population.kidComparison: About 29.9 million people live in Cameroon—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Warm tropical climate year-round with distinct wet and dry seasons.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Cameroon
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Cameroon.

exploration.didYouKnow: Cameroon is located in Middle Africa and its capital city is Yaoundé.
